svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.text: Keep your hands on the home row
All 48 layer keys are within one row of the home row (16 are on it): the number row and the F-row are never needed,
arrows, Esc, Backspace and Ctrl never need the hand to leave home. Same layout on Linux (keyd) and macOS (Karabiner).
Esc on Caps, Ctrl under the thumb, Backspace one key above Enter; Right Alt / Right Ctrl are held by the right thumb
Digits on the left hand in a 3×3 + 0 block, symbols around them, arrows on hjkl, Home/PgUp/PgDn/End under them
F1–F12 on the same block as the digits: F1 = 1, F2 = 2, …
